transcript.content: Hello. I am a psychiatrist here to help you today. What brings you to the clinic?

Hello doctor. For about a year and a half now, I've been experiencing an overwhelming amount of energy and an abnormally elevated, high mood. It has just been really difficult for me to slow down at all.
During these times of high energy, did they ever cause major disruptions in your life, like requiring a hospital stay or making you unable to work?

No, I haven't been hospitalized for it, and I'm not really sure if it has disrupted my work. It's just that this constant high energy and my racing thoughts have been going on nonstop for over a year now.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the exact opposite—such as feeling very down, empty, or losing interest in your usual activities?
No, I haven't really felt down or empty at all. My mood is typically very high and energized, so I haven't lost interest in any of my activities.
Have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or holding strong beliefs that others tell you aren't true?

I don't hear or see things that aren't there, but I definitely hold beliefs that others try to argue with. I know with absolute certainty that I am an exceptionally special person with a grand, unique mission in this life, even if people try to tell me it's not true. I just know my purpose.
Have there been times when your mood and energy returned to normal, but you still held onto these beliefs about having a special mission?

To be honest, I'm not really sure about that. My energy has been so consistently high for over a year now that I haven't really thought about whether those beliefs would stay if my energy levels went back to normal.
Before this past year and a half of high energy, did you ever hold these beliefs about having a special mission during a time when your mood was completely normal for at least two weeks?
No, I don't recall ever having those beliefs about a special mission before this high energy started a year and a half ago. Those feelings really only began when my energy levels shot up.
